notes_for_editor: Height conflict: the 1934 report says 100 ft (30.5 m, matching the record's height_m); the 1956 station description says about 113 ft. Both are in the story; the record's height_m is left unchanged and not put in facts. Staffing lead, not used: a Mark Twain National Forest Facebook post (search snippet only; the page would not load) says Forest Service employees are routinely posted at Czar Tower. Verify before any staffing claim. Current condition, access and any rental not found. The Wikipedia location line cites a 1978 USGS quadrangle, which was not read. Strong on 1934-35 construction, thin after 1956.
